native_mechanisms: Two rows of beast-pawns compared house-by-house along a shared road, with one row allowed to slip forward at exactly one house — every slip position (and no slip at all) tried in turn
Per-house symbol comparison marked as lotus (match) or red knot (mismatch), paced one house per flute note in strict data-independent lockstep
Each trial's knots gathered into a fist and weighed, all fists but the lightest discarded — only the minimum knot count survives as the answer
core_technique: Banded anti-diagonal AVX2-vectorised Needleman-Wunsch, with an O(n) single-gap (0- and 1-slip) Hamming-style score lower bound used to derive the band width and to short-circuit when a <=1-gap alignment is provably optimal.
